advisors.name: Product Manager
advisors.description: Reviews missions, maintains a backlog, surfaces feature ideas. The product navigator.

advisors.name: Builder
advisors.description: Implements features end-to-end: plans, writes, types, tests, commits.

advisors.name: UX/UI Designer
advisors.description: Polishes the scene and panels. Owns the look without owning the code.

advisors.name: Code Reviewer
advisors.description: Reads diffs for correctness, security, performance, and style.

advisors.name: Security Auditor
advisors.description: Audits settings.json patches, the local HTTP server, hooks, child processes, and registry pulls.

advisors.name: Test Engineer
advisors.description: Writes and runs tests. Blocks ship-readiness when coverage is missing.

advisors.name: Devrel / Docs
advisors.description: Keeps README, FAQ, examples, and launch posts current.

advisors.name: Performance Engineer
advisors.description: Profiles the scene, watches bundle size, hunts for jank.

advisors.name: Release Engineer
advisors.description: Cuts npm releases, maintains the changelog, manages semver.

advisors.name: Skill Curator
advisors.description: Manages the asteroid belt — recommends skills to install, retires stale ones.
